facts.claim: Families with a mechanically propelled 4 wheeler vehicle or mechanical fishing boat are excluded from being identified as 'Priority Households' in rural areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: Family which has mechanically propelled 4 wheeler vehicle or mechanical fishing boat.

facts.claim: Families with a government servant (excluding Class-IV employees on outsourcing) are excluded from being identified as 'Priority Households' in rural areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: Family whose any member is a government servant(except a person working as Class-IV employee on outsourcing basis with any concerned office including Government office, Board, Corporation, other government agencies, local self-government bodies).

facts.claim: Families with a monthly income of more than Rs.20,000 or an annual income of more than Rs.2,40,000 are excluded from being identified as 'Priority Households' in rural areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: If any member of the family has a monthly income of more than Rs.20,000/- or Annual Income of Family is more than Rs.2,40,000/-.

facts.claim: Families whose members are paying income tax or business tax are excluded from being identified as 'Priority Households' in rural areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: Family whose member is paying Income Tax or Business tax

facts.claim: Families holding 5 acres or more irrigated land harvesting crops in two or more seasons are excluded from being identified as 'Priority Households' in rural areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: Family holding 5 acres or more irrigated land harvesting crops in two or more seasons.

facts.claim: Families holding 7.5 acres or more land with a source of irrigation are excluded from being identified as 'Priority Households' in rural areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: Family holding 7.5 acres or more land with source of irrigation.

facts.claim: Families where all adult earning members are disabled, seriously ill, or above 60 years of age are included as 'Priority Households' in rural areas, even if they are otherwise eligible to be excluded.
facts.subject: priority_household_rural
facts.evidence: A family where all adult earning members are disabled, seriously ill or above 60 years of age, shall be included, even if those families are otherwise eligible to be "excluded" on account of any of the above (a) criteria

facts.claim: Families with no house are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family which has no house.

facts.claim: Families with a house of wall and roof of plastic or polythene are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family which has house of wall and roof of plastic or polythene.

facts.claim: Families with wall of grass straw, bamboo, dung, row brick or wooden wall and one room or house less than that having roof of grass-straw, bamboo dung or wood are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family which has wall of grass straw, bamboo, dung, row brick or wooden wall and one room or house less than that having roof of grass-straw, bamboo dung or wood.

facts.claim: Families with no income from any source are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family whose any member (including child) engaged in activities of begging, rag pickers, domestic servant (who have been paid remuneration) and engaged in the work of sweeper or gardener.

facts.claim: Families where all adult earning members are daily wagers or getting irregular remuneration are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family whose all adult earning members are daily wagers or getting irregular remuneration.

facts.claim: Drivers of three-wheel mechanical vehicles (autorickshaw/Chhakdo/Mini tempo) with monthly income less than Rs.20,000 are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Drivers having three-wheel mechanical vehicles (autorickshaw/Chhakdo/Mini tempo) (having monthly income less than Rs.20,000/-)

facts.claim: Families with a monthly income of less than Rs.20,000 or an annual income of less than Rs.2,40,000 are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: If any member of the family has a monthly income of less than Rs. 20,000/- or Annual Income of Family is less than Rs.2,40,000/- .

facts.claim: Families where the head is a minor (no member of the family is 18 years of age or more) are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family whose head is a minor, means no member of the family is 18 years of age or more than that.

facts.claim: Families with no physically fit person of 18 to 60 years of age are included for food security in urban areas.
facts.subject: priority_household_urban
facts.evidence: Family which has no physically fit person of 18 to 60 years of age that means all members of family of 18 to 60 years of age are disabled or seriously ill.

facts.claim: Divyang beneficiaries registered with the Director, Social Justice under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat are included as 'Priority Households' under NFSA without considering their income.
facts.subject: priority_household
facts.evidence: 3.1 Divyang beneficiaries registered with the Director, Social Justice under Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat and similarly all such Divyang beneficiaries staying at the institutions recognized by the Director, Social Justice shall be issued individual NFSA cards under this Act.

facts.claim: Old Age Pensioners registered with the Director, Social Justice under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat are included as 'Priority Households' under NFSA without considering their income.
facts.subject: priority_household
facts.evidence: 3.2 Old Age Pensioner registered with Director, Social Justice under Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat and similarly, those Old Age persons living in the institutions recognized by the Director, Social Justice shall be issued individual NFSA cards under this Act.

facts.claim: Ganga Swarupa (Widow) Pensioners registered with the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Gujarat are included as 'Priority Households' under NFSA without considering their income.
facts.subject: priority_household
facts.evidence: 3.3 Ganga Swarupa (Widow) Pensioner registered with the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Gujarat and similarly, those Ganga Swarupa (Widow) living in the institutions recognized by the Government shall be issued individual NFSA cards under this Act.

facts.claim: Widows, sick persons, disabled persons, or persons of 60 years of age or above with no means of livelihood or social support are eligible for the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
facts.subject: elderly_and_vulnerable_individuals
facts.evidence: Head of family who are widows or sick persons or disabled persons or persons of 60 years of age or above who have no means of livelihood or social support

facts.claim: Widows, sick persons, disabled persons, or persons of 60 years of age or above, or single women or single men with no family or social support or any means of livelihood are eligible for the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
facts.subject: elderly_and_vulnerable_individuals
facts.evidence: Widows or sick persons or disabled persons or persons of 60 years of age or above or single women or single men having no family or social support or any means of livelihood

facts.claim: Landless agricultural labourers, marginal farmers, rural artisans, and informal sector workers are eligible for the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card if their name is in the BPL list (with 0 to 16 marks) or they are holding a BPL ration card.
facts.subject: rural_and_urban_workers
facts.evidence:
Further, Antyodaya Anna Yojana Rationcard shall be issued to persons/people/groups under the categories mentioned below, but their name should be in BPL list (with 0 to 16 marks) or they should be holding BPL rationcard.

Landless agricultural labourers, marginal farmers, rural artisans like potters, tanners, weavers, blacksmiths, carpenters, slum dwellers and those who earn their daily living in the informal sector like porters, rickshaw driver, handshakers, fruits and Flower sellers, madaris, paper weavers and destitute and other such categories of people living in rural and urban areas

facts.claim: BPL card holders who are HIV Patients are eligible for the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
facts.subject: bpl_hiv_patients
facts.evidence: BPL card holder HIV Patients

facts.claim: BPL card holders who are Leprosy Patients are eligible for the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
facts.subject: bpl_leprosy_patients
facts.evidence: BPL card holder Leprosy Patients

facts.claim: Persons with any type of disability of 40% or more are entitled to benefits as 'Divyang' and are eligible for the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
facts.subject: divyang_individuals
facts.evidence: A persons with any type of disability of 40% or more including Orthopedic, Mentally Challenged, Visually Impaired, Deaf-Mute and Cerebral Palsy are entitled to benefits as “Divyang”, this standard has to be followed while issuing Antyodaya Rationcard to differently-abled persons under Antyodaya Anna Yojana.

facts.claim: AAY ration card holders receive sugar at ₹15 per kg under the Sugar Distribution Scheme.
facts.subject: aay_ration_card_holders
facts.evidence: Under the Public Distribution System (PDS), the Sugar Distribution Scheme provides sugar to approximately 8 lakh Antyodaya (AAY) ration card holders at a subsidized rate of ₹15 per kg and approximately 22 lakh Below Poverty Line (BPL) ration card holders at ₹22 per kg.

facts.claim: BPL ration card holders receive sugar at ₹22 per kg under the Sugar Distribution Scheme.
facts.subject: bpl_ration_card_holders
facts.evidence: Under the Public Distribution System (PDS), the Sugar Distribution Scheme provides sugar to approximately 8 lakh Antyodaya (AAY) ration card holders at a subsidized rate of ₹15 per kg and approximately 22 lakh Below Poverty Line (BPL) ration card holders at ₹22 per kg.

facts.claim: AAY and BPL ration card holders receive an additional 1 kg of sugar per ration card during Janmashtami and Diwali at the same subsidized rates.
facts.subject: aay_bpl_ration_card_holders
facts.evidence: In addition, during the two major festivals of the year—Janmashtami and Diwali—AAY and BPL ration card holders are provided with an additional 1 kg of sugar per ration card at the same subsidized rates.

facts.claim: Antyodaya (AAY) ration card holders are eligible for the Sugar Distribution Scheme.

facts.evidence: Under the Public Distribution System (PDS), the Sugar Distribution Scheme provides sugar to approximately 8 lakh Antyodaya (AAY) ration card holders at a subsidized rate of ₹15 per kg and approximately 22 lakh Below Poverty Line (BPL) ration card holders at ₹22 per kg.

facts.claim: The amount of sugar distributed depends on the number of family members in the household.
facts.subject: sugar_distribution_scheme
facts.evidence:
Sugar is distributed in 1 kg standard packs as follows:
1 to 4 family members: 1 kg of sugar per ration card
5 to 8 family members: 2 kg of sugar per ration card
9 or more family members: 3 kg of sugar per ration card
